output.summary: Arts' gap is mostly a SlotBook artifact: 42% of Arts tickets were routed to P4 under RR-17, with a 21-day median, and removing them closes about 70% of the gap. Non-SlotBook Arts tickets match non-Arts tickets within 0.3 days by category, so general deprioritisation is not supported. The Lindqvist Tuesday/Thursday on-site cover explains most of the remainder. ACK-P4 hides the best-effort status from requesters. Whether ITS told Arts about RR-17 is unestablished: only an unrecorded meeting exists. Ticket volume is not fully explained by SlotBook, and trivial or duplicate tickets are not a driver. Clarify SlotBook's support status and fix the acknowledgement, monitor with split reporting, and hold off on the desk transfer or decommissioning.
